Theorem 2.1 requires setting τ ≥ 3ε∞ which can always be achieved by setting τ sufficiently large. However, setting τ = O(ε∞ ) yields the best guarantee, and so, we would like to choose τ in a data-dependent fashion to adapt to the misspecification level. Proposition B.2 shows that this can be done while recovering essentially the same guarantee as in Theorem 2.1.
